attestations.text: TSÊNG Ching 曾靜 (T. 蒲潭), 1679–1736, Jan. 31, executed for defaming Emperor Shih-tsung, was a native of Yung-hsing, Hunan. A licentiate in the district school, he was deprived of his degree when he failed in one of the annual examinations.
